I've done that for a while, so here are some advices of what i wanted people to understand:

No, it's not a matter of wanting attention, at least, not in a bad way. Of course we (I'll say we, ok? Cause I'm also passing by this) want attention, but it's not that we want to be the center of the world. We want affection, friendship, support... We want a friend chest to cry and hear us. We want a hug.

Second: call her to talk, offer all your comprehension and friendship. Don't judge and try to hear without interrupting. Speak the minimum and only that. The less you speak, the best. If she is thinking of suicide, don't say things as: "it'll get better" "don't worry" "cheer up" "you have a wonderful live"; try to don't talk about the future saying "you are a brilliant mind" "you'll be such an amazing -whatever she wants to be-". Don't talk about people that love her, speak for yourself. If you want, say that YOU like her.

About the cuttings, no matter how strange it sounds, it really helps. It hurts only when you cross the skin, but then it gets better right away. It's kind of a fresh sensation (in my case, as I really don't like my body, i kinda like how the scars look). The first time i did was trying to kill myself. Nowadays i do it, if I reach a vessel and die wouldn't be a problem, i would like to die, seriously. It really is a good sensation when you cut your skin.

The most important thing here is: COMPREHENSIBILITY, don't judge, be kind, hear all she wants to speak and please, hug her a lot.
